title: Baazi
desc: An honest officer is framed for murder when he starts investigating a case. However, he manages to escape from prison and goes undercover as a woman to unravel the conspiracy.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Biswasghatak
desc: Prashanta loses everything when his employee Aditya deceives him during a difficult time. Years later, Aditya's son falls for Prashanta's daughter and things take an ugly turn.

title: Badnam
desc: Mathur Ghosh's cruelty drives Haranath to suicide. Years later, Haranath's son Shankar grows up determined to avenge his father's death by seeking justice against the evil Mathur Ghosh.

title: Geet Sangeet
desc: Abandoning his affluent background, a man chases his musical dreams. However, he finds himself employed as a driver and becomes smitten with his boss's daughter.

title: Suorani Duorani
desc: The king of Kishangarh marries a girl, unaware that she is a demoness. Upon learning the truth about his stepmother, the prince decides to save his father and their kingdom from her evil plans.

title: Bhalobasar Rajprasade
desc: Bikas, a rich boy falls in love and gets married to Krishna. However, Krishna is constantly tortured by Bikas' family members.
